summary: In the sitting room, Morpheus rises from a couch as the priestess escorts Neo out. Once the two of them are alone, Morpheus puts his hand on Neo's shoulder and tells him he doesn't have to tell anyone what the Oracle told him, because what was said was meant for him alone. Neo nods and takes a bite of his cookie.

what_changes.before: Standing apart, rising from a couch as the priestess escorts Neo out.
what_changes.after: He closes the distance and puts his hand on Neo's shoulder, offering protection.
what_changes.evidence: When they are alone, Morpheus puts his hand on Neo's shoulder.

what_changes.before: Just out of his private session with the Oracle, its contents unguarded.
what_changes.after: Bound to keep what was said secret, as Morpheus tells him it was for him alone.
what_changes.evidence: You don't have to tell anyone what she told you. What was said was said for you and you alone.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus pulls Neo aside after the Oracle's reading to keep its contents between them.
